name: The Princess Trapped
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
My name is Myzrael.  I am a princess of the earth, and my captors, the giants, have trapped me deep beneath the Arathi Highlands.  These crystal shards are the only way I can speak with the surface world.

Please help me.  Allies of the giants, the Drywhisker Kobolds, have a shard like this one in their Drywhisker Gorge, to the east.  To power the cluster, you must gather Motes of Myzrael from the kobolds and apply them to it.

I beg you, adventurer, aid me!
narrative.objectives: Gather 12 Motes of Myzrael, then bring them to the Iridescent Shards in Drywhisker Gorge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah! You activated these shards. Already I feel more myself!

But alas, I am still far from free...
narrative.requestItemsText: This cluster of shards looks much like the Shards of Myzrael.  But the same feeling of security does not pulse through them.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 37 to 50, 25,800 XP in all.

quests.name: The Princess Trapped
quests.objectiveText: Gather 12 Motes of Myzrael, then bring them to the Iridescent Shards in Drywhisker Gorge.

quests.name: Stones of Binding
quests.objectiveText: Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key from the Stone of West Binding, the Stone of East Binding and the Stone of Outer Binding. Bring them to the Stone

quests.name: Myzrael's Allies
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern of Ironforge.

quests.name: The Lost Fragments
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Torn Scroll Fragment, the Crumpled Scroll Fragment and the Singed Scroll Fragment to Theldurin the Lost.

quests.name: Summoning the Princess
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her. Gather her Eldritch Shackles and bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.
